REST API

                    
Integrate into your CI/CD pipeline.

                    
                    

                        

                            
Analyze Package

                            POST /analyze
                            
curl -X POST -F "file=@package.deb" http://localhost:8000/analyze

                        

                    

                    
                    

                        

                            
Generate Nix Expression

                            POST /generate
                            
curl -X POST -F "file=@package.deb" http://localhost:8000/generate

                        

                    

                    
                    

                        

                            
Download from URL

                            POST /download
                            
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"url":"https://..."}' http://localhost:8000/download

                        

                    

                

                

                    
CLI Usage

                    

# Analyze package
python main.py package.deb

# Generate default.nix
python main.py package.deb --output-dir ./mypackage

# Universal analyzer
python universal_analyze.py package.AppImage

# Start web server
python server.py

# With URL
python main.py --url https://example.com/package.deb
